title: nexu-io/open-design
claim: nexu-io/open-design — 🎨 The open-source Claude Design alternative. 🖥️ Local-first desktop app. 🖼️ Your coding agent becomes the design engine:
why_good: Turns your existing coding agent into a local-first design tool — a credible open alternative to Figma / 'Claude Design' that keeps files and IP on-device.
value: Sell a hosted/team tier and enterprise licenses to design-dev teams who want agent-driven design without shipping their files to a cloud vendor.
risk: Figma and the model vendors can bolt on the same agent-design flow; 'local-first' alone won't hold unless the agent-to-design UX is clearly better.
pick_reason: The project offers a clear product in the form of a local-first design application that can be monetized.

zh.claim: nexu-io/open-design —— 开源的「Claude Design」替代品,本地优先的桌面 app:让你的编码 agent 变成设计引擎。
zh.why_good: 把你现有的编码 agent 变成本地优先的设计工具——一个可信的 Figma /「Claude Design」开源替代,文件和 IP 都留在本机。
zh.value: 向「想要 agent 驱动设计、又不愿把文件上传云厂商」的设计-研发团队,卖托管/团队版和企业授权。
zh.risk: Figma 和模型厂商随时能接上同样的 agent-设计流程;光靠「本地优先」守不住,除非 agent→设计 的体验明显更好。
zh.hook: 让你的编码 agent 变成本地版 Figma——一个把文件留在本机的开源「Claude Design」。

hook: Your coding agent becomes a local-first Figma — an open 'Claude Design' that keeps files on your machine.
